mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds continuously without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 3.5% indicates a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a severe labor market contraction, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which depresses corporate revenue growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls and RSAFS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, strong retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 120), supply-side expansion supports corporate capacity utilization and profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 120, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust supply-side activity, which supports corporate output and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
